<script>(function(){var mm=window.matchMedia;if(!mm)return;window.matchMedia=function(q){if(/prefers-reduced-motion/.test(q)){return {matches:/no-preference/.test(q),media:q,onchange:null,addListener:function(){},removeListener:function(){},addEventListener:function(){},removeEventListener:function(){},dispatchEvent:function(){return false}}}return mm.call(window,q)}})();</script>
<style>@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Oswald:wght@600;700&family=Barlow:wght@400;600;700&display=swap');
.pbc{--navy:#0B1F44;--deep:#08142C;--gold:#F4B61E;--gold2:#E0A300;--ink:#333C4E;--muted:#5A6273;--paper:#F2F2EE;--line:#D9D9D2;
 font-family:'Barlow',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);font-size:16px;line-height:1.55;
 width:auto!important;max-width:none!important;margin-left:calc(-1 * var(--wp--style--root--padding-left,16px))!important;margin-right:calc(-1 * var(--wp--style--root--padding-right,16px))!important;margin-top:0!important;overflow-x:hidden}
.pbc *{box-sizing:border-box}
.pbc h1,.pbc h2,.pbc h3{font-family:'Oswald','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.005em;margin:0;text-wrap:balance}
.pbc .in{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 18px}
.pbc .narrow{max-width:760px}
.pbc .center{text-align:center}
.pbc .eyebrow{font:700 12px/1 'Barlow',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold2);margin-bottom:10px}
.pbc .btn{display:inline-block;background:var(--gold);color:var(--navy)!important;font:700 15px/1 'Barlow',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:16px 26px;border-radius:2px;text-decoration:none;border:0;cursor:pointer}
.pbc .btn:hover{background:#ffc93d}
.pbc .btn:focus-visible,.pbc button:focus-visible,.pbc a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:2px}
.pbc-hero{background-size:cover;background-position:center;color:#fff;padding:72px 0 56px;text-align:center}
.pbc-hero h1{font-size:clamp(38px,9vw,64px);line-height:1.02;color:#fff;max-width:14ch;margin:0 auto}
.pbc-hero .lead{max-width:40ch;margin:18px auto 26px;font-size:17px;color:#E6EAF2}
.pbc-hero .cards{display:grid;gap:14px;margin-top:40px;grid-template-columns:1fr}
@media(min-width:760px){.pbc-hero .cards{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}}
.pbc-hero .card{background:var(--navy);border-top:3px solid var(--gold);padding:22px 18px;text-align:center}
.pbc-hero .card h3{color:var(--gold);font-size:20px;margin-bottom:8px}
.pbc-hero .card p{margin:0;color:#D9E0EC}
.pbc-trust{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);background:var(--deep);padding:22px 12px;text-align:center;border-bottom:3px solid var(--gold)}
.pbc-trust b{display:block;font:700 30px/1 'Oswald',sans-serif;color:var(--gold)}
.pbc-trust span{display:block;margin-top:6px;font:600 12px/1.2 'Barlow',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#D9E0EC}
.pbc-sec{padding:56px 0;background:var(--paper)}
.pbc-sec h2{font-size:clamp(28px,6vw,40px);line-height:1.08;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:18px}
.pbc-white{background:#fff}
.pbc-dark{background:var(--navy);color:#E2E7F0}
.pbc-dark h2{color:#fff}
.pbc .chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-bottom:24px}
.pbc .chips button{font:600 14px 'Barlow',sans-serif;padding:8px 13px;border:1.5px solid var(--navy);background:transparent;color:var(--navy);border-radius:2px;cursor:pointer}
.pbc .chips button.on{background:var(--navy);color:var(--gold)}
.pbc .sub{font:600 15px 'Barlow',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin:6px 0 12px}
.pbc .grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin-bottom:26px}
@media(min-width:760px){.pbc .grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:14px}}
.pbc figure{margin:0;background:#fff;border-radius:2px;overflow:hidden}
.pbc figure img,.pbc .feat img{width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:4/3;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.pbc figcaption{font:600 13px/1.3 'Barlow',sans-serif;color:var(--navy);padding:8px 10px 10px}
.pbc .more-btn{display:block;width:100%;margin:-10px 0 30px;padding:14px;border:1.5px solid var(--navy);background:var(--navy);color:#fff;font:700 15px 'Barlow',sans-serif;border-radius:2px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s}.pbc .more-btn:hover{background:#13306A}
.pbc .points{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0 0 26px;display:grid;gap:14px;text-align:left;counter-reset:p}
.pbc .points li{counter-increment:p;padding-left:44px;position:relative;font-size:16px}
.pbc .points li::before{content:counter(p);position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:30px;height:30px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--gold);color:var(--navy);font:700 15px 'Oswald',sans-serif}
.pbc .points b{display:block;color:var(--gold);font-size:17px}
.pbc .steps{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0 0 30px;counter-reset:s;display:grid;gap:12px}
.pbc .steps li{counter-increment:s;background:#fff;border-left:3px solid var(--gold);padding:12px 14px 12px 56px;position:relative}
.pbc .steps li::before{content:counter(s);position:absolute;left:14px;top:12px;font:700 26px/1 'Oswald',sans-serif;color:var(--navy)}
.pbc .steps b{display:block;color:var(--navy);font-size:17px}
.pbc .feat{background:#fff;margin-bottom:16px}
.pbc .feat h3{font-size:22px;color:var(--navy);padding:22px 18px 6px;text-align:center}
.pbc .feat p{margin:0;padding:0 18px 18px;text-align:center}
.pbc .gscore{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:0 0 16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.pbc .gscore b{font:700 34px/1 'Oswald',sans-serif;color:var(--navy)}
.pbc .gscore span:last-child{font:600 13px 'Barlow',sans-serif;color:var(--muted)}
.pbc .stars{color:var(--gold2);font-size:18px;letter-spacing:2px}
.pbc .tcard{border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:3px solid var(--gold);padding:16px;margin:0 0 12px;border-radius:2px}
.pbc .tcard p{margin:8px 0;font-size:16px;color:var(--ink)}
.pbc .tcard footer{font:600 13px 'Barlow',sans-serif;color:var(--navy)}
.pbc .link{font:700 15px 'Barlow',sans-serif;color:var(--navy);border-bottom:2px solid var(--gold);text-decoration:none}
.pbc details{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:14px 0}
.pbc summary{font:700 16px/1.35 'Barlow',sans-serif;color:var(--navy);cursor:pointer;list-style:none;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}
.pbc summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.pbc summary::after{content:"+";color:var(--gold2);font-size:22px;line-height:1}
.pbc details[open] summary::after{content:"–"}
.pbc details p{margin:8px 0 0}
.pbc-form{background:#fff;padding-top:0}
.pbc .formbox{background:linear-gradient(rgba(8,20,44,.88),rgba(8,20,44,.92)),url('https://pratamabuild.id/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/opt-file_000000001df872078cc30e965b909eb7.jpg') center/cover,var(--navy);color:#E2E7F0;padding:28px 20px;border-radius:2px}
.pbc .formbox h2{color:#fff}
.pbc .formbox label{display:block;font:600 14px 'Barlow',sans-serif;margin:14px 0 6px;color:#fff}
.pbc .formbox input,.pbc .formbox select,.pbc .formbox textarea{width:100%;padding:13px 14px;border:0;border-radius:4px;font:400 16px 'Barlow',sans-serif;color:#13203B;background:#fff}
.pbc .formbox .btn{margin-top:20px;width:100%}
.pbc-foot{background:var(--deep);color:#D9E0EC;padding:40px 0 100px}
.pbc-foot .flogo{width:92px;height:auto}
.pbc-foot .ftag{margin:12px 0 20px;color:#D9E0EC}
.pbc-foot .fcols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;border-top:1px solid #23345A;padding-top:18px}
.pbc-foot h4{font:600 13px 'Oswald',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin:0 0 6px}
.pbc-foot p{margin:0 0 12px}
.pbc-foot a{color:#fff;text-decoration:none}
.pbc-foot .soc{display:flex;gap:8px;margin:10px 0 18px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.pbc-foot .soc a{width:34px;height:34px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:50%}.pbc-foot .soc svg{width:16px;height:16px}
.pbc-foot .copy{font-size:12px;color:#8C98B0;border-top:1px solid #23345A;padding-top:14px;margin:0}
.pbc-wa{position:fixed;right:14px;bottom:calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));z-index:9999;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:#25D366;color:#fff!important;font:700 14px 'Barlow',sans-serif;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:40px;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.25);text-decoration:none}
@media all{.pbc .btn,.pbc-wa{transition:transform .15s}.pbc .btn:hover,.pbc-wa:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}}
@media(min-width:760px){.pbc .grid.g3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
.pbc section,.pbc footer{scroll-margin-top:96px}
.pbc .vids{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin-bottom:30px}
@media(min-width:760px){.pbc .vids{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px}}@media(min-width:1100px){.pbc .vids{grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr)}}
.pbc .yt{position:relative;display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:9/16;padding:0;border:0;background:#000;cursor:pointer;overflow:hidden;border-radius:2px}
.pbc .yt img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;opacity:.9}
.pbc .yt .play{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:64px;height:64px;margin:-32px 0 0 -32px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold)}
.pbc .yt .play::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:26px;top:20px;border-style:solid;border-width:12px 0 12px 20px;border-color:transparent transparent transparent var(--navy)}
.pbc .yt .vt{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:22px 10px 10px;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(8,20,44,.9));color:#fff;font:600 13px/1.3 'Barlow',sans-serif;text-align:left}
.pbc .yt iframe{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:0}
.pbc .svc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
@media(min-width:760px){.pbc .svc{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:14px}}
.pbc .svc .feat{margin:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.pbc .svc .feat h3{font-size:17px;padding:12px 10px 4px;text-align:left}
.pbc .svc .feat p{font-size:14px;line-height:1.45;padding:0 10px 14px;text-align:left}
.pbc #proses .narrow{max-width:1080px}
.pbc #proses .steps{max-width:760px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
@media(max-width:759px){.pbc .svc .feat:last-child:nth-child(odd){grid-column:1/-1}}
.pbc .fgroup{font:700 13px 'Barlow',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold2);margin:26px 0 2px}
.pbc .fgroup:first-of-type{margin-top:6px}
.pbc .steps{display:grid;gap:12px;margin:0 auto 10px;max-width:760px}
.pbc details.step{background:#fff;border:0;border-left:3px solid var(--gold);padding:0}
.pbc details.step summary{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:14px;padding:14px 14px 14px 16px}
.pbc details.step summary .n{font:700 26px/1 'Oswald',sans-serif;color:var(--navy);min-width:20px}
.pbc details.step summary .st{flex:1}
.pbc details.step summary b{display:block;color:var(--navy);font-size:17px}
.pbc details.step summary .st span{font-weight:400;color:var(--ink);font-size:15px}
.pbc details.step p{margin:0;padding:0 16px 16px 50px;font-size:15px}
.pbc #layanan .svc .feat{background:var(--paper)}
.pbc .pantau{display:grid;gap:34px;align-items:center}
@media(min-width:860px){.pbc .pantau{grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr}}
.pbc .lead2{color:#D9E0EC;font-size:17px;max-width:46ch;margin:0 0 18px}
.pbc .pl{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0 0 26px;display:grid;gap:14px}
.pbc .pl li{padding-left:30px;position:relative;color:#D9E0EC}
.pbc .pl li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:5px;width:16px;height:16px;background:var(--gold);clip-path:polygon(14% 52%,0 66%,38% 100%,100% 22%,86% 8%,38% 72%)}
.pbc .pl b{display:block;color:#fff;font-size:17px}
.pbc .op-phone{background:#F4F6FB;border:10px solid #050B19;border-radius:30px;max-width:360px;width:100%;margin:0 auto;padding:14px 12px 10px;color:#13203B;box-shadow:0 24px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.pbc .op-top{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:10px}
.pbc .op-top b{display:block;font:700 15px 'Barlow',sans-serif;color:var(--navy)}
.pbc .op-top span{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.pbc .op-tabs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);background:#E3E6EE;border-radius:8px;padding:3px;margin-bottom:10px}
.pbc .op-tabs span{text-align:center;font:600 12px 'Barlow',sans-serif;padding:6px 0;border-radius:6px;color:var(--muted)}
.pbc .op-tabs .on{background:#fff;color:var(--navy);box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.08)}
.pbc .op-kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:6px;margin-bottom:8px}
.pbc .op-kpis div{background:#fff;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 6px;text-align:center}
.pbc .op-kpis small{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.pbc .op-kpis b{font:700 20px 'Oswald',sans-serif;color:var(--navy);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.pbc .op-kpis .ok{color:#1E9E57}
.pbc .op-card{background:#fff;border-radius:8px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:8px}
.pbc .op-h{font:700 12px 'Barlow',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:6px}
.pbc .op-chart{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
.pbc .op-leg{display:flex;gap:14px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.pbc .op-leg i{display:inline-block;width:14px;height:3px;margin-right:5px;vertical-align:middle}
.pbc .op-leg .l1{background:#9AA4B8}.pbc .op-leg .l2{background:var(--gold)}
.pbc .op-ph{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px}
.pbc .op-ph figure{margin:0;background:none}
.pbc .op-ph img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/3;object-fit:cover;border-radius:4px;display:block}
.pbc .op-ph figcaption{font-size:10.5px;padding:3px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.pbc .op-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;font-size:12.5px;padding:6px 0;border-top:1px solid #EEF0F5}
.pbc .op-row:first-of-type{border-top:0}
.pbc .op-row b{font-size:11.5px;white-space:nowrap}
.pbc .op-row .paid{color:#1E9E57}.pbc .op-row .due{color:#B07800}.pbc .op-row .wait{color:var(--muted)}
.pbc .op-foot{text-align:center;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px}
.pbc .pantau.pantau-d{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}
.pbc .pantau-d .ptxt{max-width:820px}
@media(min-width:860px){.pbc .pantau-d .pl{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;column-gap:30px}}


.pbc .opd-wrap{position:relative;width:100%;height:760px}
.pbc .opd-stage{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:960px;height:760px;transform-origin:0 0}
.pbc .ap{padding:12px 14px}
.pbc .ap-cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px;margin-bottom:6px}
.pbc .ap-cards.six{grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr)}
.pbc .ap-c{background:#fff;border:1px solid #E1E5EE;border-left:3px solid #B8923A;border-radius:6px;padding:7px 9px}
.pbc .ap-c small{display:block;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#5E6780}
.pbc .ap-c b{display:block;font-size:19px;font-weight:800;color:#13295B;line-height:1.2}
.pbc .ap-c span{font-size:10px;color:#5E6780}
.pbc .ap-c.ok b{color:#1E8E4F}.pbc .ap-c.ok{border-left-color:#1E8E4F}
.pbc .ap-leg{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;justify-content:center;font-size:10.5px;color:#3A4460;margin:4px 0}
.pbc .ap-leg i{display:inline-block;width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;margin-right:5px;vertical-align:-1px}
.pbc .ap-chart{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
.pbc .ap-chart .ax{font:10px Inter,Arial,sans-serif;fill:#5E6780}
.pbc .ap-chart .axt{font:700 10px Inter,Arial,sans-serif;fill:#3A4460;letter-spacing:.06em}
.pbc .ap-chart .lb{font:700 10px Inter,Arial,sans-serif;fill:#fff}
.pbc .ap-sub{font-size:10.5px;color:#5E6780;margin:0 0 8px}
.pbc .ap-t{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:10.5px;background:#fff}
.pbc .ap-t th{background:#0B1F44;color:#fff;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;text-align:left;padding:6px 6px}
.pbc .ap-t td{white-space:nowrap;padding:5px 6px;border-bottom:1px solid #EDF0F5}
.pbc .ap-t .n{text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.pbc .ap-t .dv td{background:#E4EAF6;font-weight:700;color:#13295B}
.pbc .ap-t .tot td{background:#E4EAF6;font-weight:800;color:#13295B}
.pbc .pg{display:inline-block;width:56px;height:6px;background:#E3E7EF;border-radius:4px;margin-right:6px;vertical-align:middle;overflow:hidden}
.pbc .pg i{display:block;height:100%;background:#16876A}
.pbc .s{font-style:normal;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:9px}
.pbc .s.ok{background:#DDF3E6;color:#1E8E4F}.pbc .s.run{background:#FFF1D6;color:#A76B00}.pbc .s.no{background:#ECEEF3;color:#5E6780}
.pbc .ap-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px}
.pbc .ap-h{font-size:18px;color:#1B2440}.pbc .ap-h b{color:#B8923A}
.pbc .ap-sel{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.pbc .ap-sel span{font-size:10.5px;border:1px solid #C9D2E3;background:#fff;padding:5px 8px;border-radius:4px}
.pbc .ap-sel .ap-btn{background:#1F4FB5;color:#fff;border-color:#1F4FB5;font-weight:700}
.pbc .ap-sec{font-weight:800;font-size:12.5px;color:#13295B;border-left:3px solid #B8923A;padding-left:8px;margin:4px 0 8px}
.pbc .ap-info{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;background:#EEF1F6;border-radius:6px;padding:7px 10px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px}
.pbc .ap-info small{display:block;font-weight:400;color:#5E6780;font-size:10px}
.pbc .ap-note{background:#FFF8E4;border:1px solid #F0D58A;border-radius:6px;padding:8px 10px;font-size:11px;margin-top:4px}
.pbc .pdf{position:absolute;bottom:40px;width:430px;height:608px;background:#fff;border-radius:3px;box-shadow:0 26px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.5);transform-origin:50% 100%;overflow:hidden;font-family:Inter,'Segoe UI',Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;color:#1B2440;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.pbc .pdf.p1{left:120px;transform:rotate(-14deg)}
.pbc .pdf.p2{left:225px;transform:rotate(-7deg) translateY(-16px)}
.pbc .pdf.p3{left:330px;transform:rotate(0deg) translateY(-30px)}
.pbc .pdf.p4{left:450px;transform:rotate(7deg) translateY(-34px)}
.pbc .pdf-h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;background:#0B1F44;padding:10px 12px;border-bottom:3px solid #F4B61E}
.pbc .pdf-h img{width:24px;height:auto}
.pbc .pdf-h b{display:block;color:#fff;font-size:12px}
.pbc .pdf-h span{color:#AEB9CF;font-size:8.5px}
.pbc .pdf-h em{margin-left:auto;font-style:normal;color:#F4B61E;font-size:9px;font-weight:700}
.pbc .pdf-b{padding:10px 12px;flex:1;overflow:hidden}
.pbc .pdf-sec{font-weight:800;font-size:11.5px;color:#13295B;border-left:3px solid #B8923A;padding-left:7px;margin-bottom:8px}
.pbc .pdf-f{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:6px 12px;font-size:7.5px;color:#8C98B0;border-top:1px solid #EDF0F5}
.pbc .pdf .ap-cards{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:5px;margin-bottom:6px}
.pbc .pdf .ap-c{padding:5px 6px}.pbc .pdf .ap-c b{font-size:14px}.pbc .pdf .ap-c small{font-size:7px}.pbc .pdf .ap-c span{font-size:8px}
